in_hindi.name: चन्द्रजित

in_marathi.name: Chandrajit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon God's Radiance
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandrajit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Chandra, the Moon God, and Jit, meaning 'victory'. This name signifies the one who is victorious and possesses the radiance of the Moon God.

in_bengali.name: Chandrajit
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Moon God's Radiance
in_bengali.long_meaning: Chandrajit একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from Chandra, the Moon God, and Jit, meaning 'victory'. This name signifies the one who is victorious and possesses the radiance of the Moon God.
